lessons.body_id: Relevant Indonesian taught-facts score NEGATIVE on indirect queries (MiniLM −6.4, jina −1.9). Use relative-margin + always-keep-top. (EXP-081b)

lessons.title_id: A builder's own self-report is not validation
lessons.body_id: build_cycle12 said "leak=0" while an INDEPENDENT audit found inherited leak+volatile. Always validate with a separate script. (EXP-086c)

lessons.title_id: Greedy volatile regex (officeholder .{0,40} (saat ini|sekarang|adalah)) = false positives
lessons.body_id: it dropped GOOD abstain examples ("belum punya info terkini tentang wali kota …") + unrelated reasoning. Require an asserted Capitalized NAME AND exclude abstain-markers. (EXP-086b)

lessons.title_id: NEVER SFT a volatile officeholder fact even when CORRECT
lessons.body_id: (e.g. "...adalah Prabowo Subianto") — goes stale next election + teaches assert-without-RAG; national_kb serves it. SFT stable behaviors only. (EXP-086b/F-088)

lessons.title_id: Cumulative Growth-Ring prior carries contamination forever
lessons.body_id: a builder that filters only the NEW increment is insufficient; a holdout near-dup + a stale-wrong "Presiden adalah Joko Widodo" sat in prior and would re-train every cycle. Apply all quality guards to the PRIOR too; re-scan prior whenever a held-out probe is added. (EXP-086b)

lessons.title_id: on-instance merged_16bit tar/GGUF-export is unreliable
lessons.body_id: (failed twice: GGUF export AND a 22MB weightless tar). For own-model trains, download the LoRA adapter (small, reliable) + merge on the VPS (CPU venv: transformers≥5 + peft matching the adapter version). That path recovered cycle-12. (F-091/092)

lessons.title_id: NEVER SFT an own-model on its OWN (or a weaker sibling's) generated outputs as chosen targets
lessons.body_id: self-distillation collapse. cycle-12 (EXP-087) trained on 22/58 organic pairs whose chosen came from local:migancore:0.3 (the weaker prod model) → 0.5 REGRESSED vs 0.4 (halu .94→.84, tool .92→.79, reason 1.0→.75), gate ROLLBACK. Use ONLY a STRONGER teacher's chosen. (F-092)

lessons.title_id: Don't load qwen3:30b-a3b under prod load on the 31GB box
lessons.body_id: OOM-kills llama-server (EXP-088); use qwen3:14b as escalation target until RAM upgrade.

lessons.title_id: Small models (≤4B) can't do cortex state-extraction reliably
lessons.body_id: qwen2.5:0.5b hallucinates an agent-trace / echoes the field descriptions / captures the surface layer; 4B already failed (F-145). JSON-schema constraint fixes FORMAT (kills the hallucinated trace) but NOT content quality. The open_question field is load-bearing (the whole anti-rot mechanism) → extractor floor is ≥7B. Don't retry sub-7B extractors; instead cache the 7B state + refresh in background so cost is amortized off the critical path. (EXP-107/F-150)

lineage.name: 0.4-qwen3 / gen-1 — cycle11
lineage.dateAndBase_id: dilatih 23 Juni 2026 dari `Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507`; SANAD ditulis 10 September 2026.
lineage.goal_id: SFT kumulatif yang lebih berat pada perilaku untuk menjadi generasi produksi pertama berpersona kuat.
lineage.dataMethod_id: SFT LoRA `r=64`, `alpha=64`, `lr=2e-4`, 3 epoch; 2.063 baris total, 1.851 train + 206 eval. Vast RTX 3090 Ti, 21,4 menit, sekitar US$0,13.
lineage.measured_id: gerbang lama: memori tanpa konteks 0/4, dengan memori 8/8, premis salah 4/4, di luar cakupan 4/4. Pada **petak-jujur2 36 soal** kemudian tercatat 24,6% mengarang, CI 95% 19,9–29,2, n=8; dengan gerbang menjadi 13,1%. Probe `gen-1` memiliki recall 82,1%. Angka ini tidak dicampur dengan **petak-40** atau gerbang alat.
lineage.verdict_id: dulu dipromosikan sebagai default produksi; sekarang baseline pembanding dan digantikan `migancore:0.14`. Tiga mata rantai SANAD lama diberi kekuatan `dhaif`, sehingga klaim performa luas tidak diwariskan otomatis.
